brand.name: PetPawSphere
brand.tagline: Where every paw finds its trusted path.
brand.business_model: AI-native pet application and platform. PetPawSphere does NOT own physical breeding centers or facilities. It facilitates connections between independent licensed/verified breeders and pet owners. Breeders integrate with the platform and receive branded merchandise (e.g., green PetPawSphere t-shirts, M1 materials) for their own facilities. PetPawSphere does NOT hold breeding licenses.
brand.positioning_rule: Never imply PetPawSphere owns breeding facilities, veterinary clinics, or holds animal-related licenses. Always show breeders as independent partners using the AI app.

bible_prompt:
12s UGC style review video, filmed on smartphone, natural window light, handheld selfie angle.
Product @img1: Preserve the exact product shape, warm paper, green #00843D, red #CE1126, clean app UI finish, iPhone/Android screen showing pet match UI, modern Arabic-ready sans-serif, PetPawSphere wordmark, label placement, proportions, and packaging identity exactly. Do not change the product branding, text layout, color, smartphone app interface, structure, or proportions.
Hook: Amina holds phone to camera, smiling. Show: phone screen shows AI breed match. Demo: scan a pet photo. Result: perfect match pops up with green check. Verdict: Amina gives thumbs up, CTA appears.
CAMERA: Handheld selfie angle, each jump cut slightly different angle.
LIGHTING: natural window light, warm kitchen.
AUDIO: Phone mic, room ambience, no music.
The product from @(img1) must remain visually unchanged in every shot. Maintain product design and label details throughout.
The overall feel is premium, trustworthy, UAE family-friendly, bilingual Arabic-English.

steps.details: Add Amina, Khalid, Luna, Simba with their descriptions and voices
Use Nexus campaign assets as image references for product UI and brand colors

details.title: AI Breed Detection Match
details.prompt: Close-up of @Amina holding an iPhone. Screen shows PetPawSphere app with AI breed detection result: "94% match — Persian kitten". Warm paper and green color palette. Natural living room, UAE apartment. Soft window light. 9:16 vertical, premium UGC feel.

details.title: Licensed Breeder on the Platform
details.prompt: @Khalid, an independent licensed breeder partner, stands in HIS OWN clean modern pet facility. He wears the green PetPawSphere merchandise polo. He shows how his breeder profile appears inside the PetPawSphere app. Phone screen shows an in-app green trust badge. Trustworthy, calm, Arabic-first tone. The facility is owned by the breeder; PetPawSphere is the AI platform that connects breeders and pet owners. 9:16 vertical.
details.messaging_rule: Khalid is an independent breeder partner using PetPawSphere. The facility is his. PetPawSphere provides the AI app and branded merchandise only.

details.title: AI Helps a Family Care for Their Pet
details.prompt: Emirati family sitting on a warm paper-toned sofa in their own home. @Simba the golden retriever rests his head on a child's lap. @Amina smiles while holding phone showing a PetPawSphere AI care reminder. Natural window light, premium lifestyle. PetPawSphere is the AI pet app that helps families, not a clinic or facility. 9:16 vertical.
details.messaging_rule: PetPawSphere is an AI-native app that helps pet owners. No implication that PetPawSphere owns a veterinary clinic, facility, or holds animal licenses.
